name: indexa-capital-mcp
description: Read-only access to your Indexa Capital investment accounts: user data, account details, portfolio and performance
long_description:
A local MCP server written in Go, with no external dependencies, exposing four read-only tools against api.indexacapital.com.

The Indexa Capital API token is not itself read-only — the same credential authorises contributions and withdrawals. This server is the cage that makes it read-only: a closed whitelist of four fixed GET paths, no passthrough of paths or free-form parameters, and every tool declared read-only so a client can act on the guarantee instead of reading it in prose.

The token lives in the macOS Keychain and never leaves this Mac — not in files, not in logs, not in a response.

Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Indexa Capital.

tools.name: indexa_capital_user
tools.description: Authenticated user's data and the list of their accounts (codes)

tools.name: indexa_capital_account
tools.description: Basic information for an account (status, risk profile)
